answer.reason: Both help local home-service businesses win customers, so the paying customers overlap. Thryv sells SaaS and done-for-you marketing to small local service businesses. Angi runs a consumer-facing marketplace that sells leads and exposure to pros, and it also serves homeowners. The offerings overlap only in lead generation and visibility, and the business models differ (software and services vs marketplace). That makes it adjacent, not a direct competitor.
